MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Judge: Richard B. Ulmer Jr., Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

George A. Weinkauf, Esq. appeared with palintiff Otilia C. Torres, who was placed under oath and examined.
Mr. Weinkauf also appeared for plaintiffs Lawrence Lee Fabiani, Christina M. Torres and Patricia A. Torres, who were not present at today's hearing.
James Lucas and Manuel Torres, witnesses for plaintiff, were placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendants Richard Fabiani, Martha C. Lamas, a/k/a Martha Crecenisia Lamas, a/k/a Crecensia Martha Lamas, or Ramesh Patel.
Default was entered against defendant Rafael Fabiani on June 19, 2009.
Default was entered against defendant Martha C. Lamas, a/k/a Martha Crecenisia Lamas, a/k/a Crecensia Martha Lamas, on September 30, 2009.
Default was entered against defendant Ramesh Patel on April 7, 2010.
Doe defendants were dismissed today, October 19, 2010.
All other defendants have been dismissed.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiffs Otilia C. Torres, Lawrnece Lee Fabiani, Christina M. Torres and Patricia A. Torres, and against the Defaulted Defendants Richard Fabiani, Martha C. Lamas, a/k/a Martha Crecenisia Lamas, a/k/a Crecensia Martha Lamas, and Ramesh Patel as follows:

Plaintiffs Otilia C. Torres, Lawrence Lee Fabiani, Christina M. Torres and Patricia A. Torres are the sole and equal owners, a joint tenants in fee simple to the real property located at 347 Athens Street, San Francisco, CA.

Any claim of lien or interest in the real property existing prior to October 19, 2010 are hereby extinguished.

Counsel for plaintiff shall submit a proposed order to the Court by October 20, 2010.
